advanced.description: Root directory, Pi executable override, and terminal-scrollback limits.

pi-executable.description: Override the bundled Pi executable with a custom one. Leave empty to use the discovered system Pi (recommended).
pi-executable.label: Pi executable path

root-directory.description: Where Ensemblr stores repositories and workspaces. This should be an empty directory you do not modify directly. Changing this will reconcile your repository list against the new root.
root-directory.label: Ensemblr root directory

scrollback.description: Maximum size of each terminal pane scrollback buffer. Larger values keep more history at the cost of memory.
scrollback.label: Terminal scrollback limit

advanced.title: Advanced

accessible-colors.description: Theme optimized for color vision differences.
accessible-colors.label: Accessible colors

code-ligatures.description: Use font ligatures in file editors and diffs.
code-ligatures.label: Code ligatures

code-theme.description: Syntax highlighting for code blocks and editors. Each theme follows the app theme, using its light cut in light mode and its dark cut in dark mode.
code-theme.label: Code theme

mono-font.description: Font used for code and diffs. The bundled Nerd Font is the default; custom fonts must be installed on your system.
mono-font.label: Mono font

terminal-font.description: The bundled Nerd Font is the default; enter another font name exactly as installed to override it.
terminal-font.label: Terminal font

terminal-font-size.description: Adjust the size of text in the integrated terminal.
terminal-font-size.label: Terminal font size

diagnostics.description: Setup gate checks for Pi, git, GitHub, Linear, and the Ensemblr runtime. The diagnostics bundle redacts secrets, account ids, and full paths before going to the clipboard.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

environment.description: Environment variables used by Ensemblr and passed to agent sessions, scripts, and terminals.

empty.description: Add a variable to make it available in this environment.
empty.title: No variables set

env-files.description: Load environment variables from env files. In the native file picker, press <kbd>Cmd+Shift+.</kbd> to show hidden files.
env-files.title: Env files

sheet.empty-value-hint: Use an empty value to set this variable to an empty string.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.name-rule: Variable names may only contain letters, numbers, and underscores.

environment.title: Environment

auto-run.description: Start a repository's run script automatically after setup when no repository-specific setting overrides it.
auto-run.label: Auto-run after setup

experimental.description: Developer-only controls and early automation defaults.

developer-mode.description: Show developer-only diagnostics and Pi debug controls.
developer-mode.label: Developer Mode

experimental.title: Experimental

auto-convert.description: Convert pasted text over 5000 characters into text attachments.
auto-convert.label: Auto-convert long text

caffeinate.description: Prevent your Mac from sleeping while an agent is actively working. Shuts off below 10% battery.
caffeinate.label: Caffeinate while agents are running

context-usage.description: Always show context usage. By default, only shown when more than 70% is used.
context-usage.label: Always show context usage

follow-up.description: Queue messages to send after the agent finishes, or steer the agent mid-turn. Use ⌘J to queue.
follow-up.label: Follow-up behavior

language.description: Interface language. System follows your macOS language order.
language.label: Language

notifications.description: Get notified when an agent finishes working in a chat.
notifications.label: Desktop notifications

tool-calls.description: Show all tool calls expanded by default instead of collapsed. Toggle with {{shortcut}}.
tool-calls.label: Don't collapse tool calls

archive-on-merge.description: Automatically archive a workspace after merging its PR.
archive-on-merge.label: Archive on merge

branch-prefix.description: Prefix for new workspace branch names.
branch-prefix.label: Branch name prefix

delete-branch.description: Delete the local branch when archiving a workspace. To delete the remote branch, configure it on GitHub.
delete-branch.label: Delete branch on archive

git.description: Workspace branch defaults and lifecycle behavior. Repository-scope overrides win when set.

rename-workspace.description: Ask the agent to rename a workspace from its placeholder composer name, and its git branch to match, once it knows what the work is. Off leaves the placeholder name in place.
rename-workspace.label: Let agents name the workspace and branch

set-upstream.description: Configure new Ensemblr workspaces so plain `git push` sets a branch upstream. Turning this off avoids writing Git worktree config, but PR info may be less reliable until branches have an upstream.
set-upstream.label: Set upstream on plain `git push`

git.title: Git

linear.disconnected: Connect Linear to browse issues, manage them from Ensemblr, and create workspaces from issues.
linear.not-configured: Add app.linear.clientId to ~/.config/ensemblr/config.json to enable Linear sign-in. Linear is optional for local and GitHub-only workflows.
linear.reconnect-required: The stored Linear token expired and cannot be refreshed automatically. Reconnect to continue using Linear workflows.

default-model.description: Model used when you start a new chat. Falls back to the agent-reported default when unset.
default-model.label: Default model

models.description: Agent models and thinking-level defaults for new chats and reviews. Sourced from each configured runtime's capability discovery.

review-model.description: Model used for the Review action on a workspace.
review-model.label: Review model

models.title: Models

visibility.description: Hide models you don’t use from the model picker and the default/review selects. Hiding the selected default or review model switches it to the first available.
visibility.label: Model visibility
visibility.locked: At least one model must stay visible

account.description: Reported by the provider for the credentials Ensemblr will use.
account.empty: The provider reported no account details.
account.label: Account

checks.description: Everything Ensemblr probes before it will start a chat on this runtime.
checks.label: Readiness checks

providers.description: Agent runtimes that can drive a chat. Each one resolves its own executable, reports its own readiness, and keeps its own credentials.

executable.description: Override the discovered {{command}} binary with a custom one. Leave empty to use the executable found on PATH (recommended).
executable.label: {{provider}} executable path

runtime.probe-failed: Ensemblr could not probe the {{command}} executable.

settings-file.description: {{provider}} reads its own configuration from this file. Ensemblr never edits it — open it in your editor to change permissions, hooks, or MCP servers.
settings-file.label: {{provider}} settings file

providers.sign-in-hint: Sign-in is interactive: Ensemblr copies the command, you run it in a terminal.
providers.title: Providers

actions.branch-rename-description: Custom instructions for generating branch names from your messages.
actions.code-review-description: Add custom instructions sent to the agent when you click the Review button.
actions.create-pr-description: Add custom instructions sent to the agent when you click the Create PR button.
actions.description: Configure action-specific behavior and instructions for this repository.
actions.fix-errors-description: Add custom instructions sent to the agent when you click the Fix errors button.
actions.general-description: A master prompt prepended as context to the first message of every new chat in this repository.
actions.placeholder: Add your preferences here. The agent will be told to prioritize these instructions over its default instructions.
actions.resolve-conflicts-description: Add custom instructions sent to the agent when you click the Resolve conflicts button.
actions.title: Actions

archive-on-merge.description: Automatically archive a workspace after merging its PR. Overrides your user-scope default for this repo.
archive-on-merge.label: Archive on merge

archive-script.description: Runs before a workspace is archived.
archive-script.label: Archive script

auto-run.description: Start this repository's run script automatically after a new local workspace finishes setup.
auto-run.label: Auto-run after setup

branch-from.description: Each workspace is an isolated copy of your codebase. Set the upstream branch new workspaces fork from.
branch-from.label: Branch new workspaces from

delete-branch.description: Delete the local branch when archiving a workspace. Overrides your user-scope default for this repo.
delete-branch.label: Delete branch on archive

environment.description: Repository-scoped environment variables. Repository values override user defaults; secrets are stored in the macOS Keychain.
environment.title: Environment

files-to-copy.description: Ensemblr will automatically copy these file paths into each new workspace. Supports gitignore-style globs.
files-to-copy.label: Files to copy

git.committed-note: Committed <file>.ensemblr/settings.toml</file> values shared with the team still win over these personal overrides.
git.description: Per-repository git defaults. These override your user-scope git settings for this repo only.
git.title: Git

misc.description: Repository paths, preview URLs, files-to-copy patterns, and lifecycle.
misc.title: Misc

preview-urls.description: Overrides the terminal panel’s Open button URL. Add more than one to switch between them from the Open button dropdown; the first is opened by default and the rest appear in the dropdown in order. Supports `$ENSEMBLR_WORKSPACE_NAME` and `$ENSEMBLR_PORT`. Leave blank to auto-detect from output logs.
preview-urls.label: Preview URLs

remote-origin.description: Where Ensemblr pushes, pulls, and opens PRs. Read-only for now — runtime honors the git "origin" remote; a configurable remote is planned.
remote-origin.label: Remote origin

remove.description: Removes the repository from Ensemblr. The on-disk directory at<path>{{path}}</path>is not deleted; delete it manually if you want it gone.
remove.title: Remove this repository?

root-path.description: Do not move or delete this directory. Instead, remove the repository in Ensemblr.
root-path.label: Root path

run-mode.concurrent-description: Run scripts can run in multiple workspaces at once.
run-mode.description: Whether run scripts can run in parallel across workspaces.
run-mode.label: Run mode
run-mode.nonconcurrent-description: Only one run script can run at a time.

scripts.description: Commands that run when workspaces are set up, run, or archived. Saved to the repository’s committed .ensemblr/settings.toml.
scripts.diverges: The workspace you have open commits different scripts on its branch, and runs those. Merge this file to change what it runs.
scripts.title: Scripts

setup-script.description: Runs when a new workspace is created.
setup-script.label: Setup script

spotlight.description: Replace Run with Spotlight for this repository so workspace changes are tested in the repository root. Spotlight is a separate feature still in development (workspace→root diff/apply with rollback); see docs/product/discovery-spotlight-testing.md.
spotlight.label: Use spotlight testing

workspaces-path.description: Do not move or delete the workspace subdirectories. Instead, archive workspaces in Ensemblr.
workspaces-path.label: Workspaces path

run-scripts.description: Shortcuts for quick actions, like running your dev server or test suite. Use <port>$ENSEMBLR_PORT</port> for the workspace's allocated port.

editor.default-description: Runs when you press ⌘R in a workspace that has no other pick.
editor.description: Shortcuts for quick actions, like running your dev server or test suite. Use <port>$ENSEMBLR_PORT</port> for this workspace's allocated port.
editor.duplicate-name: Another run script already uses this name.
editor.name: Name

run-scripts.empty: No run scripts yet. Add one to get started.
run-scripts.title: Run scripts
